text: Implement a Rust function that deduplicates a Vec while preserving insertion order.
expected_response: Use a HashSet to track seen elements and retain only the first occurrence of each value, preserving original insertion order.

text: Debug Rust borrow checker error when mutably iterating and pushing to the same vector.
expected_response: Collect the values to add into a separate Vec first, then extend the original vector after the immutable borrow ends.

text: Optimize Rust parser allocation by reducing String cloning in hot loop.
expected_response: Replace owned String copies with borrowed &str slices in the hot loop, using Cow<str> only when mutation is needed.

text: Implement binary search in Rust over a sorted slice of i32.
expected_response: Use a manual binary search loop with low and high bounds, comparing the midpoint to the target and narrowing the range each step.

text: Refactor Rust config parser to return Result with typed errors.

text: Implement a Rust iterator adapter that skips consecutive duplicates.
expected_response: Implement a custom Iterator wrapper using Peekable to skip elements equal to the previously yielded value.

text: Debug lifetime mismatch in Rust function returning a borrowed str.
expected_response: Add an explicit lifetime parameter tying the return &str to the input reference so the compiler knows the borrow is valid.

text: Optimize Rust hashmap usage for counting events in streaming input.
expected_response: Use the entry API with or_insert(0) to count occurrences in a single hash lookup per key, avoiding redundant contains_key checks.

text: Implement async Rust request handler with timeout and retry policy.
expected_response: Wrap the async request in tokio::time::timeout and retry on failure up to a maximum number of attempts with backoff.

text: Refactor Rust CLI argument parsing to use clap derive.
expected_response: Use clap's derive macros to declaratively define CLI arguments as struct fields with attributes for help text and defaults.
expected_code:
use clap::Parser;

#[derive(Parser, Debug)]
#[command(name = "myapp", about = "A sample CLI tool")]
struct Cli {
    #[arg(short, long)]
    input: String,
    #[arg(short, long, default_value_t = false)]
    verbose: bool,
    #[arg(short, long, default_value_t = 4)]
    threads: usize,
}

text: Write Rust tests for tokenizer behavior on punctuation and unicode.

text: Implement an LRU cache in Rust with O(1) operations using HashMap and order tracking.
expected_response: Combine a HashMap for O(1) lookups with a VecDeque for tracking access order, evicting the least recently used entry when capacity is reached.

text: Debug Rust panic from unwrap on None in configuration loading path.
expected_response: Replace .unwrap() calls with the ? operator to propagate None as an error, preventing panics on missing config values.

text: Optimize Rust serde deserialization to reduce allocations in hot path.
expected_response: Use #[serde(borrow)] with &str fields instead of String to enable zero-copy deserialization directly from the input buffer.

text: Refactor Rust state machine transitions into strongly typed enums.
expected_response: Model each state as an enum variant with a transition method that returns the next valid state, enforced at compile time.

text: Write Rust tests for retry policy correctness and attempt counting.
expected_response: Write #[test] functions that verify the retry policy respects the max attempts limit and increments the attempt counter correctly.

text: Implement Rust interval merge over sorted tuple ranges.
expected_response: Sort intervals by start, then iterate and merge overlapping ranges by extending the current interval's end when overlap is detected.

text: Debug Rust lifetime error involving borrowed response references.
expected_response: Return an owned String instead of a borrowed &str to avoid lifetime issues when the data is constructed inside the function.

text: Optimize Rust hashmap counting loop by reducing redundant key lookups.
expected_response: Replace separate contains_key and insert calls with entry().or_insert(0) to perform a single hash lookup per key.

text: Refactor Rust error hierarchy with thiserror and context-rich variants.
expected_response: Use #[derive(thiserror::Error)] with #[error(...)] attributes to generate Display impls and From conversions automatically.
expected_code:
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
enum AppError {
    #[error("config error: {0}")]
    Config(String),
    #[error("network timeout after {seconds}s")]
    Timeout { seconds: u64 },
    #[error(transparent)]
    Io(#[from] std::io::Error),
    #[error(transparent)]
    Json(#[from] serde_json::Error),
}
